title: Eat Protein First To Keep Muscle While Losing Fat
hook: The same calories can leave you with a completely different body.
body: Your body burns about 20-30% of the calories in protein just digesting it. With carbs, it's 5-10%. And in a McMaster University study, two groups ate the same calories with the same hard workouts. The high protein group lost more fat and gained muscle.
close: So get your protein in first at every meal. Then go to AbsByAI.com.
youtube_description:
Protein matters outside of calories. Your body burns about 20-30% of the calories in protein just digesting it. With carbs, it's 5-10%. Researchers at McMaster University put two groups of young men on the same calories and the same hard workouts. The high protein group lost more fat and gained muscle. So every meal you eat needs a big serving of meat, fish or eggs. Get your protein in first, then fit your carbs into whatever calories you have left.

title: Eat Less Without Counting Every Calorie
hook: You can eat less without counting every calorie. Here's how.
body: Researchers gave a group of adults a shorter eating window. They ate about 550 fewer calories a day, and nobody counted anything. Then a yearlong study had people fast until noon, and they did just as well as the calorie counters. When you've got fewer hours to eat, you don't have to fight yourself all day.
youtube_description:
When you've got fewer hours to eat, you eat less. University of Illinois researchers gave obese adults a 4 or 6 hour eating window each day. Nobody counted calories. After two months, they were eating about 550 fewer calories a day without even trying. Then a yearlong study had one group fast until noon every day, and they did just as well as the calorie counters. That's one more reason why I fast until 2 every day.

Learn more at AbsByAI.com:

title: Keep Your Steps Up While You Diet
hook: When you diet, your body can quietly make you move less.
body: You sit more, you take the elevator, and that can cancel out a big piece of your deficit. So set a minimum number of steps per day. I'd say 8-10K is a good target for most of you guys. Walk after dinner, take your calls on your feet, or park at the back of the parking lot.
close: Go to AbsByAI.com to get started.
youtube_description:
When you cut your calories, your body quietly makes you move less. That can cancel out a big piece of your deficit. The Mayo Clinic overfed people by the same thousand calories a day, but the fat they gained was wildly different depending on how much they moved. So set a daily step minimum. I'd say 8-10K is a good target for most of you guys. Walk after dinner, take calls on your feet, park at the back, or use a standing desk.

Try AbsByAI here:
